results.title: Illustrators report fewer commissions as image generators spread
results.finding: Freelance illustrators surveyed reported a 23% drop in commissions year over year.

results.title: Stock image marketplaces add AI collections
results.finding: Two of the three largest stock image marketplaces now sell AI-generated collections next to licensed photography.

results.title: Concept art teams adopt generative tools for ideation
results.finding: Studios use generative tools mainly for early ideation; final assets are still produced by artists.

results.title: Streaming services label AI-generated tracks
results.finding: Major streaming services began labelling fully AI-generated tracks in 2026.

results.title: Royalty pools and synthetic music
results.finding: Collecting societies are debating whether AI-generated tracks should share in royalty pools.

results.title: Publishing Workforce Report 2026
results.finding: Copy-editing roles fell 11% between 2024 and 2026 while acquisitions roles were flat.

results.title: Translation market outlook
results.finding: Machine-assisted translation now covers most commercial translation volume, with human post-editing.

partial.finding: Several VFX houses report that AI rotoscoping roughly halved the labour for that task.
